subject.title: [Feature]: Add guarded keyboard shortcuts for session/agent switching in Control UI

question: Should Control UI support guarded positional or cyclic session/agent switching shortcuts, and which bindings plus session ordering should be the supported contract?
rationale: This is new keyboard behavior that can conflict with browser/OS shortcuts and changes active session state; source inspection confirms it is not a broken existing contract.

options.title: Add Coordinated Guarded Shortcuts
options.body: Adopt non-conflicting bindings and implement them through the same guarded dashboard dispatcher as adjacent Control UI shortcuts, with active/pinned/recent ordering tests.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Keep this as part of the broader sessions-view/product work so switching, peek, and inline-reply behavior share one session workspace contract.

options.title: Decline Browser-Level Chords
options.body: Keep switching picker/sidebar or command-palette driven to avoid browser shortcut conflicts and close the shortcut direction by maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Add Coordinated Guarded Shortcuts
recommendation.body: Adopt non-conflicting bindings and implement them through the same guarded dashboard dispatcher as adjacent Control UI shortcuts, with active/pinned/recent ordering tests.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev owns the adjacent guarded shortcut issue/PR and has the closest current product context for shortcut contract choices.
